notes.title: v1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
v1.1.0 Release Notes
- Fixed a bug where the whole game freezes after some events.
- Fixed a bug where all pauses in the game took longer than expected on some computers.
- Supported Steam Cloud.
- Added an exit button on the title screen.
- Some other subtle bug fixes.

notes.title: Trick &Treat Remake is going to be released!
notes.content:
[h3]Trick &Treat Remake is planned to be released on the end September![/h3]
...if valve finished reviewing it ;v;
I believe you've seen the Remake trailer!^^
The contents of Art Book Vol.2 are finished, but it may come later than the game.
*


[h3]✩ The third popularity vote is going to end on 19th September (Sunday)![/h3]
Please vote here on the website! →[url=https://www.rabbitongames.com/survey/the-3rd-popularity-vote/]https://www.rabbitongames.com/survey/the-3rd-popularity-vote/[/url]

It'll still be there for you to vote after the end date, and the votes will be counted as the results in the next round.
The results will be released on the end of September. Thank you for your participating!


[h3]✩ Art Book Vol.2 is going to be released![/h3]
There will be some new pixel art and sketches in these 5 years🎀
